specificFindings: Johnson story preserves black trash bags versus other students suitcases; father occupation is attached to his dad, not the son or author.
The narrator inserted question anticipates the answer, while the father reply permits difference without establishing anyone financial worth or superiority.
The secret is a real short source fragment referring to happiness in the Danes, not a fabricated expanded sentence.
Many Danes said is a scoped self-report, not a universal experimentally verified population claim. Content is an adjective, lower an imperative verb.
Everyday use of satisficing is not a blanket recommendation over maximizing in all areas; it refers to the narrator own buying, planning and routine decisions.
Thus Spoke Zarathustra, Brave New World, The Land of Happy and William James work are not exchanged; Nietzsche quotations are philosophical/literary criticism, not experiments.
Smaller is within philosophical critique rather than measured height; resignation means resigned acceptance not leaving a job.
Wanderer and greatness quotations characterize a literary figure; no real-world instruction to seek danger is added.
These emotions points to sadness, anger and fear; occasional is not all the time, existing happiness is affirmed while reflection is still invited.
Fans means supporters, not a measured research sample. Flaubert letter is a sceptical literary view, not an endorsed diagnostic rule about happy readers.
Silverstein evaluation retains might be and poignant, without claiming an objective ranking or unanimity.
Down on means critical of; volunteering comparison retains its direction without an individual causal guarantee.
Tartt suggestion means sacrificing own happiness for others; it is an attributed value view rather than a fee, sole permissible lifestyle or experiment.
